tools.name: import_account_snapshot
tools.description: Loads a saved bank account snapshot file from disk and returns the account number, holder name, and current balance it contains.

params.name: snapshot_path
params.description: Path to the account snapshot file

tools.name: apply_transfer_batch_yaml
tools.description: Parses a YAML document listing transfers between bank accounts and returns the total amount and the number of transfers in the batch. It does not execute the transfers.

params.name: batch_yaml
params.description: YAML text with a list of transfers, each having from_account, to_account and amount

tools.name: restore_statement_cache
tools.description: Restores a cached list of bank statement transactions from a base64-encoded blob and returns those transactions filtered by a minimum amount.

params.name: cache_blob
params.description: Base64-encoded serialized list of transaction dictionaries

params.name: min_amount
params.description: Only return transactions with an amount at or above this value
